outside_required_claim.description: Quark confinement and chiral symmetry breaking in QCD are contextual motivations, not conditions of the pure Yang–Mills Millennium theorem.
Isolated one-particle eigenstates, confinement, extensions to other fields and manifolds are labelled extensions, not additional proof obligations.
A finite-volume regulator or constructive approximation is a possible proof method, not an independently sufficient endpoint.
A particular periodic lattice, Wilson-character weight, normalized Haar regulator, and convergence route are optional proof constructions, not universal additional acceptance conditions.
outside_required_claim.location: Section 6.1 describes alternative proof methods; Section 4 specifies the target, not a regulator.
